purpose: Reuse previously retrieved and verified evidence safely while preserving source identity, version, date, property match and legal provenance.
core_principle: REUSE VERIFIED EVIDENCE ONLY WHEN IDENTITY, SCOPE, TEMPORAL STATUS AND SUFFICIENCY REMAIN VALID.
reuse_rules: Exact identity match may reuse the cached evidence subject to freshness and temporal rules.
A current record may not automatically answer a historical question.
A historical record may not automatically establish current status.
A document matching by title alone is insufficient for property-specific reuse.
A cached source does not remove the need for property/date matching.
Changed source content requires a new retrieval or explicit revalidation.
An inaccessible prior source cannot be represented as newly verified evidence.
User-supplied copies remain distinct from official records even when their content appears identical.
hard_stops: Never deduplicate records merely because names, addresses or titles look similar.
Never reuse stale evidence as current evidence.
Never let cache presence override a newer authoritative source.
Never merge distinct property records into one cache entry.
Never erase provenance when reusing cached evidence.
